name: 07042 · Montclair, NJ
findings: ZIP 07042 (Montclair) has 208 nonprofit organizations. 107 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 86 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07042 (Montclair) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07042 (Montclair) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
